info.name: Adrash — Passenger App API
info.description:
Every endpoint the Adrash passenger mobile app consumes, generated from the .NET controllers.

**Conventions**
- Base URL: `{{baseUrl}}` (e.g. https://api.adrash.et)
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` (collection-level; anonymous endpoints override to no-auth)
- Envelope: every 2xx is `{ "success": true, "data": T, "errors": [], "meta": null | {totalCount,totalPages,currentPage,pageSize} }`
- Errors: RFC7807 ProblemDetails `{ title, status, detail, code }` — the app-specific code is the top-level `code`
- JSON is camelCase and **enums serialize as strings** (e.g. "SantimPay", "Passenger", "En")
- Money: decimal + separate `currency: "ETB"`; timestamps ISO-8601 UTC

**Two contract gotchas the client must respect**
1. `POST /bookings` has **no `seatNumbers`** — seats are server-allocated FCFS; the count comes from `passengerDetails.length`.
2. Quote `passengerFareEtb`, never `baseFareEtb` (the latter is the driver-side base and under-quotes the customer).

Run order: Auth -> Discovery -> Bookings -> Payments. Test scripts auto-capture tokens and ids into collection variables.

item.name: 1. Auth (OTP / PIN / devices)
item.description: Phone-OTP only — no passwords. First login: POST otp/send -> otp/verify. Subsequent logins on a trusted device can use pin/verify. Enums serialize as STRINGS (JsonStringEnumConverter, Program.cs:58) and all property names are camelCase.

request.description: Rate limited per phone. If the phone matches a configured TestAccount bypass phone, no real SMS is sent and the fixed bypass code always verifies.
Returns the token pair + user. `isNewUser`/`needsSetup` drive the one-time profile-setup screen. A deviceToken is returned when the device is enrolled — store it for PIN login.

request.description: Called once when verify returned needsSetup=true. Sets User.FullName. `role` is optional and only used for driver self-registration — passengers omit it.

item.name: Verify PIN (returning login on trusted device)

request.description: Three-factor: phone + 6-digit PIN + enrolled device token. Failure codes: Auth.PinNotSet, Auth.DeviceNotTrusted, Auth.PinLocked (5 wrong = 30 min), Auth.InvalidPin, Auth.AccountSuspended.
currentPin is required only when replacing an existing PIN. 6 digits; trivial sequences (123456/987654) are rejected.
Rotates: the old refresh token is revoked and a new pair issued.
Required when verify returned agreementRequired=true. Immutable record.
Phone cannot be changed here — use the phone-change OTP flow below. preferredLanguage: En | Am | Om.

item.name: 3. Discovery (routes, trips, seats)
item.description: Route + trip browsing and the seat map. GET /routes and the seat map are anonymous; the trip list/detail require a bearer token.

request.description: Public detail used by the passenger booking flow — stops (ordered), pickup locations, polyline.
Boarding points the passenger picks at booking time. Use one of these ids as pickupLocationId.

request.description: IMPORTANT: quote passengers `passengerFareEtb` (per-seat price incl. markup), NOT `baseFareEtb` (driver-side number — would under-quote).

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.data && b.data[0]) pm.collectionVariables.set('tripId', b.data[0].id);

request.description: Passengers get trip info only (no manifest).

Returns ALL seats 1..seatsTotal with a flag (not just free ones). Fields are exactly `seatNumber` (number) and `isBooked` (boolean). A seat counts as booked when a booking row exists with status != Cancelled and != NoShow — Pending (unpaid) bookings DO hold seats. Empty `seats` array only when the assigned bus capacity is 0. Not cached — reads the DB per call.

IMPORTANT — seats are NOT chosen by the client. There is no `seatNumbers` field; the server allocates first-come-first-served (lowest-numbered free seats), and the seat COUNT = passengerDetails.length (max 6). Any seatNumbers you send is ignored. Booking is created Pending and holds its seats immediately, before payment. Conflict -> 409 with code "Booking.SeatNotAvailable" (messages: "This trip is sold out." / "Only N seat(s) left..." / "Seats were booked concurrently by another request. Please try again."). A passenger may hold at most 2 Pending bookings.

request.description: method is a STRING enum: "SantimPay" | "ADC" | "Cash" (Cash is officer-only). accountRef is the payer wallet phone. Pushes a USSD/app prompt to the payer; the booking stays Pending until the provider webhook confirms it. A second initiate while one is Pending returns 409 Payment.AlreadyInProgress.

request.description: Polls the provider for a Pending transaction — use when the webhook is slow. On success the booking flips to Confirmed.

Must be >= the configured minimum redemption and <= balance. Reversed automatically if the booking is cancelled. You can also redeem inline at booking time via the pointsToRedeem field on POST /bookings.
Body is an ARRAY of preference objects (not wrapped).
score is 1..5. Only for a Completed booking you own, once per booking.
